note: Character looks (ADR 0018). Id = NPC id, enemy type or 'player'. tools/build_sprites.py bakes game/assets/characters/<id>.png from LPC parts. body = LPC body type; skin = body palette colour; parts = LPC sheet definition names with a palette colour. Colours not stated in the Book text are marked confidence 'guess'.

player.note: The player is an unnamed Earther; plain modern clothes.

relc.note: A big Drake of the Watch. Scale colour not clear in the Book 1 text.

krshia.note: A Gnoll shopkeeper. LPC wolf parts stand in for Gnoll parts.

goblin_grunt.note: Small green Goblin. Clothes come in M11.4.
